title: Fix broken category/subcategory icons by using local generated SVG assets with SafeIconImage fallback

requirements.summary: Audit and update all category/subcategory icon references so they only point to existing local SVGs under frontend/public/assets/generated (no external URLs).
acceptanceCriteria: No icon src (or CSS background-image) references an http/https URL anywhere in the app.
All category and subcategory icon references resolve to files under /assets/generated/*.svg.
All icon filenames referenced in code exist in frontend/public/assets/generated.

file_operations.description: Audit the category grid and Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid icon sources; ensure every icon src is a local /assets/generated/*.svg path (not .png, not http/https) and update any stale/broken filenames to match the generated SVG assets. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit all Local Skilled Workers subcategory icon paths; ensure every icon points to a local /assets/generated/*.svg filename that exists (and update any stale/broken paths). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden SafeIconImage so any http/https src (or any src outside /assets/generated/*.svg) is treated as invalid and replaced with the local fallback; keep the rendered and className behavior unchanged to preserve layout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Centralize icon rendering through SafeIconImage so missing/invalid icon sources always render the local fallback SVG without layout changes.
acceptanceCriteria: If an icon src is empty, whitespace, invalid, or the file fails to load, the UI renders /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg.
No broken-image placeholders appear on the Home page category grid or Local Skilled Workers subcategory grid.
No changes to spacing, grid columns, card sizes, or typography on pages where icons appear (layout remains unchanged).

file_operations.description: Confirm all category and subcategory icons on this page are rendered using the existing SafeIconImage component (no raw tags or CSS background-image for these icons), preserving all existing wrappers, sizes, and className values to keep layout unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure SafeIconImage reliably falls back to /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg for empty/whitespace/invalid src and for load errors, without changing element structure or layout-affecting attributes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add any missing local SVG icon assets (including fallback) for the current category and Local Skilled Workers subcategory taxonomy, using the exact filenames referenced by the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: All required SVG icon files exist under frontend/public/assets/generated with the exact filenames referenced by the code.
All icons are simple SVGs (no embedded external image links) and render correctly at small sizes (e.g., 64–96px) without clipping.
The fallback icon file /assets/generated/icon-fallback.dim_128x128.svg exists and is used automatically when needed.
